Pads wear fastest where you brake hardest, so the front wears about
twice as fast as the rear. The signals are squeal, a softer bite, and
the metal-on-metal scrape that means you waited too long.

Swap pads with the wheel out and the caliper bolts clean, then bed
them in with gentle stops before trusting them in traffic. Keep a
spare set in the workshop: the pads always wear out the morning of
the ride.
